findings.what: rem:K_plongement_hypotheses is given tex_lines [951, 958]. The remark ends at l.959 (\end{rem}; the ledger's tex_span is [951, 959]), and the other four rows include their \end line.

The finding itself is true and correctly cited, but its suggested repair is incomplete. It proposes 'a sentence after rem:pushup (l.1374) saying E_α is causally plain'. That sentence alone does not supply prop:tarentin_fort_K's hypothesis where prop:K_calcul needs it, namely at every E_{≥0}-manifold. That also needs E₀'s plainness and the plainness clause of theo:causalite_engendre (l.523, under its Baire hypothesis (C)). In Lean that is Causal.SFALocal.causallyPlain through causallyPlain_of_locZ, as the REPORT's own hypothesis note on this row says. The alternative is the ledger's push-up repair. Since the finding goes to the author, it should not read as if one model sentence repairs l.1565.
